The story of Octolantis

Legend has it that one day Atlantis sank beneath the waves and was lost. Windows always had a lost island too: a little island at the top of the screen, quietly keeping track of your work.

We found that island and named it Octolantis. Now a little octopus lives there, keeping an eye on your agents with all eight arms: Octo.

When something is done, Octo is the first to tell you; when you’re needed, Octo calls out.

LIGHT ON YOUR PC

Barely there.

AgentOffice stays out of the way while you work. Figures are approximate, from our own measurements.

  • It draws only when something on the island moves.
  • It reads chats from where it left off, not from the start.
  • Files on the shelf stay where they are; nothing is copied.
  • It waits for Windows to report changes instead of checking again and again.

BEFORE YOU SETTLE IN

Good to know.

Can I use the island without AI tools?

Yes. Media controls, notes, timers, alarms and water tracking work independently of AI connections in the Windows app.

Which AI tools work with the office?

This preview focuses on Claude Code and local Codex. Features vary by connection; answering a question from the office depends on what the source tool supports.

Does the shelf move my files?

No. It remembers where the originals are. Drop a file onto the shelf, switch apps, then drag it into another app. The browser preview uses sample files.

Is this the actual product?

The island uses AgentOffice’s own components, icons and mascot. The office uses its original scene. This preview supplies sample data instead of connecting to your desktop or AI accounts.

Where can I download the Windows app?

A download link will be added when the distributable installer is ready. For now, you can explore the product here.
